task-fbbf3302865d.name: T1: Discovery - Explore Verification & Security Systems
task-fbbf3302865d.description: Explore the codebase to understand the verification system (verification_standard.py) and SecurityAgent (security.py). Map the integration points for adding a SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES criterion.

task-633383b77eee.name: T2: Analysis - Security Integration Design
task-633383b77eee.description: Analyze how to integrate SecurityAgent capabilities (SAST, dependency audit, secret scanning) as a new mechanical verification criterion. Document the data flow: ImplementationResult → SecurityAgent → VerificationReport → AcceptanceCriterion check.

task-85900c7bf981.name: T3: Planning - Implementation Plan
task-85900c7bf981.description: Create a detailed implementation plan for adding SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES criterion type. Include: 1) Enum addition, 2) Verifier logic, 3) SecurityAgent integration, 4) Test criteria, 5) Acceptance criteria for the feature itself.

task-eb233959557c.name: T4: Design - Criterion Specification
task-eb233959557c.description: Design the SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES criterion specification including: criterion parameters, SecurityAgent input mapping, evidence requirements, failure modes, and integration with VerificationReport.

task-5daab2fe3998.name: T5: Implementation - Add SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES Criterion
task-5daab2fe3998.description: Implement the SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES criterion type in verification_standard.py. Add enum value, update Verifier class to handle security audit criterion, integrate SecurityAgent execution, produce evidence.

task-8c013e5b18fd.name: T6: Security Audit - Review Implementation
task-8c013e5b18fd.description: Run SecurityAgent (SAST, dependency audit, secret scanning) on the new implementation. This runs in parallel with implementation verification.

task-72639efc5644.name: T7: Testing - Verify New Criterion Works
task-72639efc5644.description: Create and run tests for the new SECURITY_AUDIT_PASSES criterion. Test with both passing and failing security audit scenarios.

task-0de487cb9355.name: T8: Verification - Independent Validation
task-0de487cb9355.description: Verifier independently validates the implementation against acceptance criteria. Checks: criterion enum exists, verifier handles it, security audit runs, tests pass, evidence chain complete.

task-ffc665a6fd57.name: T9: Human Gate - Review and Approve
task-ffc665a6fd57.description: Human reviews the verification evidence and decides whether to approve the feature for production. This simulates the human governance checkpoint.

task-1cb4fc359306.name: T10: Final Review - Mission Convergence
task-1cb4fc359306.description: Final review of the complete mission. Verify all artifacts, evidence chain, and mission-level convergence. Produce final mission report.
